<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Terrorism in Turkey]]
**[[2022 Istanbul bombing]]
***An [[improvised explosive device|IED]] explodes on [[İstiklal Avenue]] in [[Beyoğlu]], [[Istanbul]], killing six people and injuring 81 others. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/11/13/turkey-istanbul-explosion-istiklal-several-injured (Al Jazeera)]
***[[Ministry of Interior (Turkey)|Interior Minister]] [[Süleyman Soylu]] reports that a female suspect has been arrested. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2022-11-14/suspect-arrested-by-turkish-police-over-istanbul-bomb/101650812 (ABC News Australia)]
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**[[Iran–Israel conflict during the Syrian civil war]]
***[[Israel]] launches missile strikes on [[Shayrat Airbase]] in [[Homs Governorate]], central [[Syria]], killing two [[Syrian Army|soldiers]] and injuring three others, according to [[Syrian Arab News Agency|Syrian state television]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/syrian-air-defences-shoot-down-israeli-missiles-targeting-homs-province-state-tv-2022-11-13/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Mahsa Amini protests]]
**The [[Islamic Revolutionary Court]] of [[Iran]] issues the first [[Capital punishment in Iran|death sentence]] in connection with the protests. The sentenced person was [[conviction|convicted]] of [[arson|burning]] a [[government of the Islamic Republic of Iran|government]] office. [https://www.msn.com/en-au/news/other/irans-revolutionary-court-issues-first-death-sentence-against-protest-detainee/ar-AA143BOJ (MSN)]
*[[2022 University of Virginia shooting]]
**Three people are killed and two others are injured after a mass shooting at the [[University of Virginia]], [[Charlottesville]], [[Virginia]], [[United States]]. [https://apnews.com/article/shootings-virginia-charlottesville-university-of-4cd9f0a64201d2460de887674fdfa02b (AP)]
'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2022 Slovenian presidential election]]
**Independent [[liberalism|liberal]]  [[Nataša Pirc Musar]] defeats her [[right-wing politics|right-wing]] opponent [[Anže Logar]] in a run-off vote and will become the country's first female [[President of Slovenia|president]]. [https://foreignbrief.com/daily-news/slovenia-to-hold-runoff-for-2022-presidential-election/ (''Foreign Brief'')] [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/nov/13/natasa-pirc-musar-expected-to-become-slovenia-first-female-president (''The Guardian'')]

'''Sports'''
*[[2022 Formula One World Championship]]
**[[2022 São Paulo Grand Prix]]
***[[Formula One drivers from the United Kingdom|British racing driver]] [[George Russell (racing driver)|George Russell]] of [[Mercedes-Benz in Formula One|Mercedes]] wins the first [[Formula One]] race of his career. [https://edition.cnn.com/2022/11/13/motorsport/george-russell-sao-paolo-grand-prix-spt-intl/index.html (CNN)]
